goal: A body-on-chip brain compartment is scaled to an adult (70 kg, cardiac output 5000 mL/min) and the chip carries 2e6 cells. Report the brain compartment's organ flow fraction and the organ flow rate (mL/min) it receives.
source: Blind design target (cold): the brain receives ~15% of cardiac output — the committed body-on-chip flow-fraction table (labwright/calc/scaling.py:ORGAN_FLOW_FRACTIONS, sourced to Ucciferri, Sbrana & Ahluwalia, Allometric Scaling and Cell Ratios in Multi-Organ in vitro Models of Human Metabolism, Frontiers in Bioengineering and Biotechnology 2014, doi:10.3389/fbioe.2014.00074). The goal text states neither the fraction nor the flow; not in the Labwright system prompt either.
